title: Match Manifest (v0)
description: One frozen, deterministic, executable encounter. Harmonia schedules these across M1-M4 without knowing how to design players or worlds. The manifest is complete: any qualified host given this manifest and the referenced content-addressed artifacts MUST produce the identical trace hash. Match identity is derived, not assigned: match_id = hash(canonical serialization of the frozen fields), which makes submission idempotent by construction -- the same experiment is the same match everywhere, forever.

match_id.description: hash over (world_hash, player_hashes, player_checkpoint_hashes, seed, resource_budget, execution_version, tier, prospective_test_id). DERIVED, never minted. Duplicate execution of the same match_id is by definition a replay, and replays must agree.

world_hash.description: content hash of the world genome (worldfoundry.world_genome.v0)

player_hashes.description: frozen player manifests from Proteus, one per slot, in slot order

player_checkpoint_hashes.description: per-slot learned-state checkpoint, null = fresh. A checkpoint may only be referenced after the match that produced it is QUALIFIED in the ledger -- a scheduling race that references an unqualified checkpoint is a rejected manifest, not a warning.

seed.description: episode master seed; every stochastic stream in the encounter derives from it by named substream

resource_budget.description: May tighten but never exceed the world genome's resource_constraints. Debited atomically from the campaign budget lineage at match commit.

execution_version.description: engine release identity (build-derived source hash) the match must run under. A host on a different release MUST refuse the claim.

scheduling_policy_version.description: identity of the Harmonia policy that emitted this manifest. Policies are versioned and replayable; 'why was this match scheduled' must always be answerable.

tier.description: staged-qualification tier. Tier budgets and promotion statistics are preregistered per (tier x horizon_class) stratum -- horizon stratification exists so cheap early death does not silently select against slow-developing strategies.

prospective_test_id.description: null for landscape/soup encounters. Set when this match executes a preregistered prospective test (a crucible arm, a PEW proposal, a calibration arm). The test must be COMMITTED in the ledger (irreversible commit boundary) BEFORE this manifest is created; evidence for a test that predates its commit is inadmissible by construction.

pairing_class.description: why these players are in this world -- the scheduling intent, recorded so pairing bias is analyzable

$comment: EXECUTION CONTRACT: (1) a worker claims a manifest via the engine's lease-fenced claim (claim_id fencing; heartbeats; expiry reassignment); (2) executes deterministically; (3) submits the outcome under the engine idempotency key = match_id, so a crash-after-execute-before-commit resolves to exactly-once evidence, and two workers racing the same manifest converge on identical traces or trigger a DETERMINISM_BREACH incident (which is a stop-the-line event, not a data point to average over); (4) worker health, retries, host telemetry are recorded OUTSIDE the scientific ledger. INFRASTRUCTURE_ABORT outcomes (wall-clock kill, host loss) are never player outcomes and never enter any landscape statistic.
